fusions.name: Guillotine Leap
fusions.desc: You launch at a target up to 5 tiles away and bring your jaws down on it, dealing 27 damage, up to 1.6 times that at full range. The blow ignores its armour.

fusions.name: Felling Tail
fusions.desc: Your tail chops through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage, knocking enemies 2.5 tiles back and giving each a 50% chance of [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drift Log
fusions.desc: Drops a felled trunk 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Hewing Jaw
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
